_readme: This file documents the Zap structure for the 'AI Website Template Generator' automation.
It is a reference/config export, NOT a Zapier-importable .zap file (Zapier does not support
importing arbitrary JSON as a Zap). Use this as the blueprint while building the Zap manually
in the Zapier editor -- see implementation_guide.md for the click-by-click steps.
Fields marked "MANUAL CONFIG" must be set inside the Zapier UI and cannot be pre-filled here.
zap_name: AI Website Template Generator (GHL -> Claude -> GitHub -> Email)

trigger.description: Receives the POST from the GoHighLevel chatbot/workflow webhook action. 'Catch Raw Hook' is used (instead of 'Catch Hook') so we get the full raw body and headers for signature verification.

config.webhook_url: MANUAL CONFIG -- generated by Zapier when this step is created, e.g. https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/123456/abcdef/

trigger.expected_payload_shape: See ghl_webhook_payload.json for the full sample and field schema.
security: Configure GHL to send a shared-secret header (e.g. X-Webhook-Secret) and verify it in Step 1 (Parse & Validate) before proceeding.
Never trust the payload's github_credentials.personal_access_token blindly -- validate format (ghp_... or github_pat_...) before use.

steps.name: Parse & Validate Input
steps.description: Validates required fields from the GHL webhook, normalizes types, trims/sanitizes free-text input, and halts the Zap early (with a clear error) if anything required is missing or malformed. Keeps the expensive Claude + GitHub steps from running on bad input.
steps.code_file: See a lightweight inline validator below; for anything beyond basic shape checks, reuse the validation block at the top of claude_api_integration.js.
inline_code_summary: 1. Compare webhook_secret_header to the value stored in Zapier Storage; throw if mismatched.
2. Require: contact_email (valid email regex), template_description (10-2000 chars),
3. Default css_framework to 'none' and template_variant to 'general' when omitted.
4. Strip control characters from template_description to prevent prompt/log injection.
5. Return a clean, typed object for the next steps to consume.

error_handling.on_validation_failure: throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: <reason>') so the Zap run shows a clear failure reason in Zap History.
error_handling.recommended_zap_setting: Enable 'Continue on error' is NOT recommended for this step -- a failed validation should stop the Zap and (optionally) branch via Paths by Zapier to send a 'we could not process your request' email.

steps.name: Generate HTML Template via Claude API
steps.description: Calls the Anthropic Messages API with the validated template description and returns the generated HTML.

input_fields.claudeApiKey: MANUAL CONFIG -- map to a value from Storage by Zapier (key: 'anthropic_api_key'), NEVER paste the raw key into this field

error_handling.retry_policy: 3 attempts, exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) on HTTP 429 and 5xx only. 4xx (other than 429) fail immediately -- retrying won't help a bad request or bad key.
error_handling.note: Zapier Code steps have their own execution ceiling (~30s legacy / 180s on newer plans) -- keep max_tokens and retry counts within that budget.

steps.name: Commit Template to GitHub
steps.description: Creates (or updates) an HTML file in the user's GitHub repo under templates/, using the Contents API.

output_fields.rawUrl: string -- raw.githubusercontent.com link for direct preview

error_handling.on_401: throw new Error('GITHUB_AUTH_FAILED: token invalid or missing required scopes')
error_handling.on_409_or_422: refetch the file SHA once and retry the PUT a single time (handles a race on an existing file), then fail.
error_handling.on_403_rate_limit: read X-RateLimit-Reset header, wait if under Zapier's step time budget, otherwise throw a clear rate-limit error.

steps.name: Send Confirmation Email
steps.app: Email by Zapier (or Gmail / SendGrid / GHL Email action)
steps.description: Sends the user a confirmation email with links to the generated template.

input_fields.subject: Your AI-generated website template is ready!
input_fields.body_html: email_template.html, with the placeholders below replaced by Zapier's field mapper

error_handling.on_send_failure: Zapier will natively retry transient email-provider errors; if it still fails, the Zap run is marked Error and (if enabled) triggers Zapier's built-in 'Zap failed' email alert to the account owner.

error_path.description: Optional 5th branch (Paths by Zapier) evaluated when any of steps 1-4 fail.
error_path.condition: Zap Run Status == Error (via Zapier's native error notifications) OR Step 1 output isValid == false
error_path.action: Send an internal alert (Slack/Email) to the founder with the failed step, error message, and the original contact_email so they can follow up manually.
error_path.user_facing_fallback: Optionally send the user a generic 'we hit a snag generating your template, our team has been notified' email so they aren't left wondering.

template_request.description: A modern landing page for a boutique coffee roastery, warm earth tones, hero section with a signup form for a subscription box.

extensibility_notes.phase_2_solana: Insert a new Code-by-Zapier step (step 3.5) after 'Commit Template to GitHub' that: (1) uploads the generated HTML to IPFS/Arweave, (2) calls a Solana program to mint a fractional-ownership NFT referencing the content hash, (3) stores the mint address alongside the GitHub commit metadata (e.g. in Storage by Zapier or an Airtable/Postgres record) for later marketplace revenue-share calculations.
extensibility_notes.template_variants: css_framework and template_variant are already threaded through steps 1-2 specifically so new variants (e.g. 'portfolio', 'saas', 'ecommerce') or frameworks (e.g. 'tailwind', 'bootstrap') can be added by extending the system-prompt builder in claude_api_integration.js without touching the Zap wiring.
